title: #48. The Battle Of Tabook 1
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَٰذَا

وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنْ شَاءَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا۝وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا بِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَلَا

وَلَا يُحَرِّمُونَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَلَا يَدِينُونَ دِينَ الْحَقِّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ حَتَّىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُعْطُوا الْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يَدٍ وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُمْ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ وَلْيَجِدُوا فِيكُمْ غِلْظَةً وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُتَّقِينَ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُمْ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ وَلْيَجِدُوا فِيكُمْ غِلْظَةً ۚ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُتَّقِينَ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَا لَكُمْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمُ انْفِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ أَرَضِيتُمْ بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ ۚ فَمَا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ۝

اثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِلَّا تَنْفِرُوا يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَيَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّوهُ شَيْئًا ۗ

وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ۝

إِلَّا تَنْصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ اللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ثَانِيَ اثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِي الْغَارِ إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَاحِبِهِ

إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَاحِبِهِ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَيَّدَهُ بِجُنُودٍ لَمْ تَرَوْهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا السُّفْلَىٰ ۗ وَكَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا ۗ

وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

اِنْفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا وَجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ۝

اِنْفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا لَيْسَ عَلَى الضُّعَفَاءِ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرْضَىٰ وَلَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ مَا يُنْفِقُونَ لَا يَجِدُونَ مَا يُنْفِقُونَ حَرَجٌ إِذَا نَصَحُوا لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ

مَا عَلَى الْمُحْسِنِينَ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ۝

اَلْحَسَنَةْ بِعَشَرَةْ اَمثالِهَا مَا ضَرَّ عُثْمَان مَا فَعَلَ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمَ وَإِذَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَجَاهِدُوا مَعَ رَسُولِهِ

اسْتَأْذَنَكَ أُولُو الطَّوْلِ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالُوا ذَرْنَا نَكُنْ مَعَ الْقَاعِدِينَ۝

رَضُوا بِأَنْ يَكُونُوا مَعَ الْخَوَالِفِ وَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ۝

رَضُوا بِأَنْ يَكُونُوا مَعَ الْخَوَالِفِ وَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ۝

لَٰكِنِ الرَّسُولُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ جَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الْخَيْرَاتُ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ۝

أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ۝

وَجَاءَ الْمُعَذِّرُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ وَقَعَدَ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ سَيُصِيبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ۝

لَا اَجِدُ مَا أحمِلُكُمْ عليهَا فَرِحَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ وَلَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ إِذَا مَا أَتَوْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ قُلْتَ لَا أَجِدُ مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ

تَوَلَّوْا وَأَعْيُنُهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ الدَّمْعِ حَزَنًا أَلَّا يَجِدُوا مَا يُنْفِقُونَ۝

إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ وَهُمْ أَغْنِيَاءُ رَضُوا بِأَنْ يَكُونُوا مَعَ الْخَوَالِفِ وَطَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

لو كَانَ عَرَضًا قَرِيبًا وَسَفَرًا قَاصِدًا لَاتَّبَعُوكَ وَلَٰكِنْ وَلَٰكِنْ بَعُدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّقَّةُ وَسَيَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ لَوِ اسْتَطَعْنَا لَخَرَجْنَا مَعَكُمْ

يُهْلِكُونَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ۝

عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْكَ لِمَ أَذِنْتَ لَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَتَعْلَمَ الْكَاذِبِينَ۝

لَا يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالْمُتَّقِينَ۝

إِنَّمَا يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَارْتَابَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فَهُمْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي رَيْبِهِمْ يَتَرَدَّدُونَ۝

وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِنْ كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انْبِعَاثَهُمْ وَلَٰكِنْ كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انْبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ

فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ اقْعُدُوا مَعَ الْقَاعِدِينَ۝

لَوْ خَرَجُوا فِيكُمْ مَا زَادُوكُمْ إِلَّا خَبَالًا وَلَأَوْضَعُوا خِلَالَكُمْ يَبْغُونَكُمُ الْفِتْنَةَ وَفِيكُمْ سَمَّاعُونَ لَهُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالظَّالِمِينَ۝

لَقَدِ ابْتَغَوُا الْفِتْنَةَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَقَلَّبُوا لَكَ الْأُمُورَ وَقَلَّبُوا لَكَ الْأُمُورَ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ كَارِهُونَ۝

سَتَرْغَم لَه’ اُنُفْ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ ائْذَنْ لِي وَلَا تَفْتِنِّي ۚ أَلَا فِي الْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُوا ۗ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ۝

وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ ائْذَنْ لِي وَلَا تَفْتِنِّي ۚ أَلَا فِي الْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُوا وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا

إِنْ تُصِبْكَ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ يَقُولُوا قَدْ أَخَذْنَا أَمْرَنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَيَتَوَلَّوْا وَهُمْ فَرِحُونَ۝

قُلْ هَلْ تَرَبَّصُونَ بِنَا إِلَّا إِحْدَى الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ ۖ وَنَحْنُ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمْ أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِعَذَابٍ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ أَوْ بِأَيْدِينَا ۖ

فَتَرَبَّصُوا إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُتَرَبِّصُونَ۝

السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته
english:
The Life Of Muhammadﷺ, Madinan Period Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says: O you, who have believed, indeed the polytheists are unclean.

So, let them not approach Al-Masjid Al-Haram(ألمسجد الحرام), after this, their final year and if you fear privation, Allah will enrich you from His bounty, if He wills

indeed Allah is Knowing and Wise.

The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) for centuries, their livelihood was based on doing business.

They had an influx of people coming in for Hajj(حج) and Umrah(عمره), throughout the year.

So, that was the foundation of their business.

So, what they used to do is buy and trade with the people, who are coming in to Makkah throughout the year.

That's all what they knew, how to do, they weren't into anything else.

Rasool Allah ﷺ announced to the Mushrikeen(مشركين) that after this year, and this was in the ninth year of Hijrah(هجرة), No Mushrik(مشرك) is allowed into Al-Masjid Al-Haram(ألمسجد الحرام)!

No Mushrik(مشرك) is allowed into Masjid Al-Haram(ألمسجد الحرام), into Makkah.

To the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) this was the catastrophe, the disaster, we're dead.

Because not all of the Arabs have become Muslim yet.

Yani(يعني) Najd(نجد) and all of those areas are not yet Muslim, you have Al-Hijaaz(الحجاز) is already Muslim, but the other parts of Arabia have not accepted Islam yet.

So, the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula have not become Muslim.

And these are the ones, who are going to come in and do Hajj(حج) and do Umrah(عمره).

And these are the ones whom we depend on, for our livelihood.

And now, Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying that they're banned from entering the country.

I mean, this is not good for the economy.

And by the way, not only today are people thinking about the economy, even then economy, financial resources was a major concern of the people.

And a lot of the decisions that the politicians make are based on economical reasons.

So, the people of Quraish(قريش), were thinking in economical terms and saying that this is not a wise decision.

How are we going to live?

And this is the Ayah(آية) that we just recited, Allahعَزّوجَلّ saying, O, you have believed indeed the polytheist are unclean.

That's reasoning behind the banning of Mushrikeen(ألمشركين) from entering into Al-Haram(الحرم).

The Ayah(آية) is saying that the reason why, they're not allowed in.?

Is because of their Nijasa(نجاسة).

And then Allah says: So, let them not approach Al-Masjid Al-Haram(ألمسجد الحرام) after this.

It's their final year Khalaas(خلاص), this is the last year, and this announcement was made in the ninth year of Hijrah(هجرة).

And as a response to the complaints of the people, of Quraish(قريش), they are already Muslim.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says and if you fear, privation, Allah will enrich you from His bounty, if He wills.

Indeed Allah is Knowing and Wise.

And this is Tawakkal(توكل) in Allahعَزّوجَلّ, if something is Haram(حرام), we stop from it.

If something is Halaal(حلال), we encourage people to do it.

That is how we base our decisions.

It's not on what will make us money and what will not.

So, Islam came to change the way people think, because people usually think in financial terms, and decisions are made laws are made, in that sense.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ is telling them, if you have trust in Allahعَزّوجَلّ, Allah will provide for you.

And it was difficult thing for Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) because, they didn't have any other skill or art to do and make money.

I mean, the land in Makkah is not suitable for planting anything.

It's very infertile dry land, rocky tracks and no rain.

So, when business was their only job that they knew how to do, and they're told not to do it, they were kind of concerned, they were worried.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ told them Allah will provide for you, Khalas(خلاص).

Allah will provide for you.

Let's have Eeman(إيمان) in Allahعَزّوجَلّ let's do what Allahعَزّوجَلّ told us.

And by the way, brothers, and sisters, this has many implications on us today, because there are a lot of Muslims, who deal with Ribaa(رباء), who sell Haraam(حرام) things

and the reason is, this is the only way we can make money.

So, they open a grocery store, and they sell things that are Haraam(حرام), you tell them this is Haraam(حرام), they say how are we going to live?

And then you find people buying houses using mortgages, which is a clear Ribaa(رباء) without any doubts.

And then they say, how are we going to survive, we're going to lose all of our money, if we keep on paying rent.

The response to these people is; Whoever has Taqwa(تقوى), Allah will find a way out for them and will provide them from sources they never expected.

It's a promise from Allahعَزّوجَلّ, if you have Taqwa(تقوى) and you believe in Allahعَزّوجَلّ, then this is, what will happen Allah will provide for you.

Put your trust in Allahعَزّوجَلّ and Allah will provide for you.

So, how does Allah provide for the people of Makkah?

The next Ayah(آية) verse 29.

Fight those, who do not believe in Allah, or in the last day, and who do not consider unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful,

and who do not adopt the religion of truth from those who're given the Scripture, fight until, they give the Jizya(جزيه) willingly while they are humbled.

This is how Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) starts the chapter on the events of the ninth year of Hijrah(هجرة).

And this is how he opens, his section on the Battle of Tabook(تبوك), it is by giving a brief Tafseer(تفسير) of these two Ayaat(آيات).

The order from Allahعَزّوجَلّ in verse 123, of Surah Taubah(سورة توبة), Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; O, you, who have believed! Fight those, adjacent to you, of the disbelievers

and let them find in you harshness and know that Allah is with the righteous.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, fight those adjacent to you.

Who are the ones adjacent to the Muslims now, in the ninth year of Hijrah(هجرة)?

It is the Romans.

Because the Roman Empire reaches to the boundary of Hijaaz(حجاز).
